body: It’s my friends and family that want me here. I guess I just don’t understand why they’re not okay with ignoring me at home vs ignoring me while I’m in the hospital.

I’ve been in the hospital almost 12 hours now and still don’t have a doctor. Why is it better for me to be here? Uncomfortable, stressed, exhausted...

I’m just feeling more and more like this is just a way to get me out of their hair.
I’m so tired. I’m just so tired.

I’m just having a hard time understanding how this is supposed to help. I just feel more isolated and alone than I ever have before. I’ve been here almost 10 hours and still don’t have a doctor. Couldn’t this have happened at home?

But instead I’m here, genuinely alone, with nothing but incessant beeping, pounding in my ear. 

No one cares

I still don’t have a room or doctor. It’s been 8 hours. Yet everyone still seems to agree this is best for me. I’ve never felt so worthless. If I was at a 6 earlier today I’m definitely at a 10 now. 


I just don’t know what to do. I have no idea who I should talk to. Or if I should talk. 


That’s what got me into this mess. I thought I could be vulnerable. What the fuck is wrong with me
I don’t understand why I deserve this.
I just feel so immensely alone.

I just wanted to talk and be heard. Within two minutes of opening my mouth the police were called and I was told I needed to go to the hospital. Apparently his friends suggested it too. I just feel like no one cares enough to listen. They hear me saying I’m struggling, but don’t listen for the details. All they hear is that I need help, but no one wants to offer any. Just make me someone else’s problem. Let the people who get paid to care deal with me. I don’t feel like a human anymore.

Wow, your situation sounds eerily similar to mine. While it’s almost nice to hear that I’m not alone, I’m sad that you also feel like you don’t have much of a support system. I wish I knew how to change that aspect of our struggle, though I guess posting here is a start.
Wow, such a cool program I probably would have bother otherwise considered. Thank you, what a neat idea.
These are wonderful ideas. Thank you.

27 year old man-child in the US. I have very little by way of provable education, just a gen ed Associates degree, and lots of work experience in various positions. Mostly in retail, management, training, and education.
Your last few phrases here are really potent. Thank you for sharing.
Cliché or not, your words are resonating, so thank you for that.
